description: This file is a shell script that provides utilities for managing Git worktrees associated with pull requests, including functions to switch to a worktree, retrieve PR metadata, list PR worktrees, and clean up old worktrees.

methods.name: repo_root
methods.description: Determines the canonical root directory of the repository, resolving via git common-dir or fallback to parent directory.

methods.name: enter_worktree
methods.description: Switches to the worktree for a specific pull request, optionally resetting to main.

methods.name: pr_meta_json
methods.description: Fetches detailed pull request metadata in JSON format using GitHub CLI.

methods.name: write_pr_meta_files
methods.description: Stores PR metadata into JSON and environment variable files for use in other scripts.

methods.name: list_pr_worktrees
methods.description: Lists existing pull request worktrees with their statuses.

methods.name: gc_pr_worktrees
methods.description: Removes merged or closed PR worktrees, with a dry run option.

methods.name: pr_number_from_worktree_dir
methods.description: Extracts the PR number from a given worktree directory name.
